question: Derive the expression for energy stored in a parallel plate capacitor in terms of the electric field between its plates. Hence obtain the energy density of the electric field. A capacitor has plate area $5.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^2$, separation $1.0\text{ mm}$ and electric field $3.0 \times 10^5\text{ N C}^{-1}$. Calculate the energy stored in it.

options.A: $U=\varepsilon_0E^2Ad$ and $u=\varepsilon_0E^2$. The numerical energy is $3.98\times10^{-9}\text{ J}$.
options.B: Using $U=\dfrac12CV^2$, $C=\dfrac{\varepsilon_0A}{d}$ and $V=Ed$, $U=\dfrac12\varepsilon_0E^2Ad$. Thus energy density $u=\dfrac{U}{Ad}=\dfrac12\varepsilon_0E^2$. For the data, $U=\dfrac12\times8.85\times10^{-12}\times(3.0\times10^5)^2\times5.0\times10^{-3}\times1.0\times10^{-3}=1.99\times10^{-9}\text{ J}$.
